title: Jack Got Me Good — EN/JA/AR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word cabaret 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal absurdist English Japanese Arabic language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Joel rang Mum from the hospital bed
Said Jack drove the buggy right into my leg
Mum said — Joel, that is not how you drive
Joel said — Mum, I wasn't driving, I was just alive

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
ジョエルは病院のベッドからお母さんに電話した [Joel rang Mum from the hospital bed]
ジャックがバギーを僕の脚に突っ込んだと言った [Said Jack drove the buggy right into my leg]
お母さんは言った — ジョエル、それが車の運転じゃない [Mum said — Joel, that's not how you drive]
ジョエルは言った — お母さん、僕は運転してなかった、ただそこにいただけ [Joel said — Mum, I wasn't driving, I was just there]

[Chorus — English]
Jack got me good, Jack got me good
I didn't see it coming like I thought I would
Broken leg, suspected, maybe the ankle too
Jack got me good — what are you gonna do

[Bridge — عربي]
جاك أصابني جيداً، جاك أصابني جيداً [Jack got me good, Jack got me good]
لم أر ذلك قادماً كما ظننت [I didn't see it coming like I thought I would]
ساق مكسورة، مشتبه بها، ربما الكاحل أيضاً [Broken leg, suspected, maybe the ankle too]
جاك أصابني جيداً — ماذا ستفعل؟ [Jack got me good — what are you gonna do?]

[Verse 3 — English]
Chas heard about it later that same night
Said — son, a golf buggy's not a bumper car, alright?

[Outro — EN/JA/AR]
Jack got me good
ジャックにやられた [Jack got me good]
جاك أصابني جيداً [Jack got me good]
That's my boy
